_comment: Violations that already existed when tools/validate-catalog.mjs was introduced.
The validator fails the build on anything NOT listed here, so new breakage cannot
merge; these entries only keep the inherited debt from blocking every pull request.
Remove an entry as soon as its cause is fixed — the validator prints a note when an
entry no longer matches anything. Fixing these belongs to the catalog sync work
(issue #4), not to the validator: the cause is upstream, see below.

allowed.reason: Upstream lists NBA 2K26 (twice) and Suicide Squad Kill The Justice League under PPSA28420; the site's own /api/export ships 11 duplicate titleIds. Needs a sync-side keying decision (issue #4).
Repo carries both 'Metaphor ReFantazio' and 'Metaphor ReFantazio Deluxe Edition' on PPSA20800; upstream has only the base game. The deluxe entry is a repo-side leftover to drop during sync.
Upstream lists UFC 5 twice under PPSA03541 with different hosts. Sync-side dedupe.
SAROS appears twice on PPSA07631 with different sizes (84825604096 vs 81067507712). Upstream has a single entry; the repo duplicate is stale.
Valkyrie Elysium is filed under PPSA07274, which belongs to Tales of Arise. Upstream lists it as the malformed id 'PPSA0724'; the repo entry inherited a wrong id.
Demon's Souls is filed under PPSA01341; upstream lists it as PPSA01342. The repo id is wrong (off by one).
Marvel's Wolverine still points at the upstream https://dlpsgame.com/... poster instead of a mirrored images/ file. Needs a poster download during sync (issue #4).
